theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (c : Rn ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (R a r s₀ b β κ : ℝ), 0 ≤ b → 0 < κ → r + s₀ ≤ a → ‖c‖ + r + s₀ ≤ R → (∀ x' ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) a, ‖f x' - (c + A x')‖ ≤ b) → V.weight (closedBall 0 R ∩ (V.support \ q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 R))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal β → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (κ * s) ≤ V.weight (closedBall x s)) → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, infDist (x - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ 2 * s₀) → ∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, infDist (x - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ max (2 * b) (2 * β / κ)
